caption:
साउथ एक्टर पवन कल्याण और अन्ना कोनिडेला के अलग होने की खबर ने इंटरनेट पर हलचल मचा दी है! 💔

रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, इस तीसरे तलाक पर इंटरनेट पर ११ ट्वीट्स सामने आए हैं। 📱

एक्टर और उनकी पत्नी ने अलग होने का एलान करते हुए कहा कि 'हम अच्छे दोस्त और समर्पित माता-पिता बने रहेंगे'। 🤝

सोशल मीडिया पर फैंस इस खबर के बाद से हैरान हैं और तरह-तरह की प्रतिक्रियाएं दे रहे हैं। 😲

क्या आपको लगता है कि सेलेब्स की पर्सनल लाइफ पर सोशल मीडिया का रिएक्शन ज्यादा ही होता है? 🗣️

ctx.title: Pawan Kalyan and Anna Konidela Separation: 11 Tweets that show how Internet reacted to Telugu actor's third divorce
ctx.summary:
In a shocking development, Pawan Kalyan parted ways with his third wife, Anna Konidela. The couple announced their separation a couple of hours before, on the day after Diwali, leaving fans and well-wishers in disbelief. Soon after their joint note went viral on social media, fans couldn't keep calm but expressed their emotions on X (formerly Twitter). Some memers also reacted to the development with a pinch of wit and humor. Here's how social media users reacted to  Pawan Kalyan  and Anna Konidela's separation.  
 A social media user tweeted, "It's really heartbreaking. No matter what happens in your personal life. I’ll continue to admire you for the rest of my life. Always with you, no matter what." Another one wrote, "This news really saddened me. I hope you move forward with strength, no matter how many challenges come your way in your personal life, Anna @PawanKalyan."  
 Since some social media users were taking a dig at his third divorce, a fan tweeted, "People are enjoying it when someone gets a divorce in their personal life. Movies, politics motham ne chutte thirigitundi. Prathi okkadu 3 wives inka politics chestharu.. nee valla vallu chala suffer avtunaru. Odhile happy ga ni life brathuku #pawankalyan.
